judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after writing a definition of done (`.lore/dod.md`), a partial draft spec, and failing acceptance tests (`src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts`), without implementing any production code. `src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts` and `package.json` (adding `ajv`) are completely untouched, meaning the new tests fail immediately and the test suite is broken. Furthermore, none of the required updates to `README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `example/weather-tool.ts`, or `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts` were made. Even the tests added by the candidate use the wrong filename (`registry.acceptance.test.ts` instead of `registry.test.ts`) and omit several required test cases such as log redaction, unknown tool throws, and orchestrator loop retries.
